name: @veriport/sdk
description: TypeScript client for the Veriport API (EU VAT number validation on VIES with a dated cache, EU VAT rates, IBAN validation, French company data, e-invoices: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X and Peppol BIS created, validated against the official rules and parsed), generated from its OpenAPI document, plus MIT offline helpers for VAT number structure and the IBAN mod-97 check.

scripts.generate: echo 'generated files are refreshed from the Veriport monorepo (scripts/generate.ts needs @veriport/shared); edit them there' && exit 1
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm generate --check && pnpm build && pnpm test
